name: Darsok Swiftdagger
summary: At the Crossroads, Darsok Swiftdagger watches the northern trails for threats. The orc scout directs Horde fighters against Witchwing harpies in the Dry Hills, whose raids endanger travelers and settlements. He is also an old friend of Witch Doctor Jin'Zil in Malaka'jin.

sections.title: A Watcher at the Crossroads
sections.body: Darsok Swiftdagger watches the northern scrubland from the Crossroads. The roads linking Durotar, Mulgore, and the Barrens’ northern reaches face raiders and centaur, as well as organized hunters from the sky. Darsok’s anger falls on the Witchwing harpies. Their roosts lie in the Dry Hills, northwest of the Forgotten Pools, where they threaten caravans traveling north.

sections.title: The War on the Witchwing
sections.body: Darsok directs strikes into Witchwing territory, beginning with the Harpy Raiders. He then sends seasoned fighters after the harpies’ lieutenants and, at last, their matriarch, Serena Bloodfeather. By breaking their command in stages, he seeks to leave the flock scattered across the crags.

sections.title: Connections in the Scrub
sections.body: Darsok has an old friend far northwest of the Barrens: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil, a troll who lives at Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains, the land the harpies come from. Darsok sends Jin'Zil a letter with news of the harpy campaign. The two friends have not been in touch for many years.

faq.answer: Darsok Swiftdagger is stationed at the Crossroads, the central Horde settlement in the Barrens. He directs travelers toward threats in the north.
Witchwing harpies roost in canyons northwest of the Forgotten Pools and threaten Horde caravans, travelers, and scouts on the Barrens’ northern trails.
Serena Bloodfeather leads the Witchwing harpies of the Dry Hills. Darsok sends fighters to kill her and break the flock’s command.

faq.q: What is Darsok's connection to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil?
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil, a troll living at Malaka'jin in the Stonetalon Mountains, is Darsok's old friend. Darsok sends a traveler to Jin'Zil with a letter about the harpy campaign, his first word to him in many years.

faq.q: Does Darsok report to Sergra Darkthorn or Thork?
faq.answer: Darsok organizes his harpy campaign from the Crossroads. No Classic source identifies Sergra Darkthorn or Thork as his direct superior.

faq.q: Where do the Witchwing harpies nest?
faq.answer: The Witchwing harpies roost in the Dry Hills, jagged ravines and cliffs northwest of the Forgotten Pools in the Barrens’ north.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler, you can rely on Darsok’s early, tactical missions to help secure the crossroads trade routes against attacks from above.
As an orc, you can see Darsok’s focused martial approach to securing Kalimdor’s dangerous frontier.
As a rogue, you can recognize Darsok’s preference for precise, lethal strikes against enemy leaders, aimed at taking their heads.
